I miss her honey bread.” He folded the note gently, tucking it into his wool coat pocket, and wondered if the child had ever made it home to his mother.","w02":"凌晨四点的城市还浸在薄蓝的夜雾里，沿街的路灯拖着昏黄的光带，将偶尔驶过的清扫车影子拉得很长。24小时便利店的玻璃门透出暖白的灯光，值夜的店员趴在柜台上打盹，玻璃柜里的三角饭团还凝着薄霜。远处高架上偶尔有夜班出租车划过，留下一串细碎的引擎声，很快又消散在空荡的风里。楼宇间只有零星几扇窗亮着灯，像撒在黑绒布上的碎星，整座城市还在沉眠，只有风卷着法桐落叶擦过墙根的轻响。","w03":"- Think of recursion like a set of nested Russian dolls: each doll opens to reveal a smaller identical-looking doll, until you reach the tiniest solid doll that cannot be opened at all.\n- Every time you open a new doll, you repeat the exact same “open the doll” action, just on a smaller, simpler version of the original object.\n- You stop once you hit the smallest, simplest version that needs no further action, then work your way back out to the largest doll you started with."}
